items.text: Good game if you love to role play but overall gameplay is just choose your starting skills and traits then maybe get screwed by an adventure then buy a ship by 40 years or sooner. Then buy permit if you have enough money and if not go scrap ship then repeat and maybe get beat up by law enforcement for illegal stuff. Also has some performance issues such as random stutters and the autosave freezes your game for a long time. Will probably be better after a few major updates and would love to see multiplayer someday but it isn't planed and that's fine.
items.text_zh: 如果你喜欢角色扮演，这是款好游戏，但整体玩法就是选择起始技能和特质，然后可能被某个冒险坑一把，然后在40岁或更早买一艘船。然后如果有足够的钱就买许可证，如果没有就去拆船，然后重复，也许还会因为非法的事情被执法部门揍一顿。还有一些性能问题，比如随机卡顿，自动保存会让游戏冻结很长时间。经过几个大更新后可能会更好，也很希望有一天能看到多人模式，但这不在计划中，那也没关系。

observations.description: 自动保存导致游戏长时间冻结
observations.evidence: the autosave freezes your game for a long time
